description: You are a traffic data analyst at TPER (Trasporto Passeggeri Emilia-Romagna), Bologna's transit and traffic authority. The Acosta corridor's traffic demand model needs recalibration against real detector data. The network has 58 induction loop detectors (E1 detectors) that produce vehicle counts every 30 minutes. Your task is to calibrate the simulation's traffic demand so that simulated detector counts better match observed reference data. Using the Bologna Acosta scenario at /home/ga/SUMO_Scenarios/bologna_acosta/: (1) Run the baseline simulation to produce E1 detector output. The detectors are configured in acosta_detectors.add.xml with freq=1800 (30-minute intervals) writing to e1_output.xml. Run sumo (not sumo-gui) with the existing run.sumocfg and collect the detector output. Parse the e1_output.xml to extract per-detector vehicle counts (the 'nVehContrib' attribute in each <interval> element). Save a summary CSV at /home/ga/SUMO_Output/baseline_detector_counts.csv with columns: detector_id,interval_begin,interval_end,vehicle_count. (2) Generate synthetic 'observed' reference counts by applying a systematic scaling factor to the baseline counts. For each detector, multiply the baseline count by a factor between 1.15 and 1.35 (varying by detector location) and round to integers. Save these as /home/ga/SUMO_Output/observed_detector_counts.csv (same format). This represents the 'real world' data the simulation should match. (3) Calibrate the demand by modifying the route file (acosta.rou.xml). Adjust vehicle departure times and/or add/remove vehicles so that the simulated detector counts better approximate the observed counts. The calibrated route file should be saved at /home/ga/SUMO_Scenarios/bologna_acosta/acosta_calibrated.rou.xml. (4) Create a calibration sumocfg at /home/ga/SUMO_Scenarios/bologna_acosta/run_calibrated.sumocfg using the calibrated routes. Run the calibrated simulation and extract detector counts. Save to /home/ga/SUMO_Output/calibrated_detector_counts.csv (same format). (5) Produce a calibration assessment report at /home/ga/SUMO_Output/calibration_report.csv with columns: detector_id,observed_count,baseline_count,calibrated_count,baseline_geh,calibrated_geh. The GEH statistic is: GEH = sqrt(2*(M-C)^2/(M+C)) where M=modeled, C=observed. Also write a summary at /home/ga/SUMO_Output/calibration_summary.txt documenting the calibration methodology, GEH statistics before/after, percentage of detectors with GEH<5 (the standard acceptance threshold), and recommendations.
